text.en: The editors of The English Hymnal complained: "It is distressing to hear 'Nun Danket' or 'St. Anne' raced through at about twice the proper speed." They marked this hymn "Very slow and majestic".
text.es: Los editores de The English Hymnal se quejaron: "It is distressing to hear 'Nun Danket' or 'St. Anne' raced through at about twice the proper speed." (da pena oír 'Nun Danket' o 'St. Anne' a casi el doble de la velocidad debida). Marcaron este himno "Very slow and majestic" (muy lento y majestuoso).
